capabilities: Move 2D graph labels above nodes by patching the Pixi.js render anchor
Move 3D graph persistent labels above nodes by scaling the Three.js sprite offset
Reposition the 3D graph hover tooltip above the cursor via a CSS snippet
Adjust label distance with a slider
extras: The 2D graph patch monkey-patches Obsidian's internal Pixi.js renderer and may break if Obsidian significantly changes its graph implementation; the 3D tooltip fix ships as a CSS snippet that may need enabling manually.
intentEvidence: Works with both the built-in 2D graph and the 3D Graph community plugin.
motivation: The behaviour was requested on the Obsidian forum and acknowledged by the team, but never changed, so the author built this plugin to fix it.
problem: Obsidian's graph view places labels below nodes and shifts them down on hover, so with an enlarged pointer the label sits under the cursor and is never visible.
summary: Accessibility plugin that moves graph node labels above nodes so an enlarged mouse pointer does not obscure them, for the 2D graph and the 3D Graph plugin.
